title: Disbursement Note: Extension of Death Claim Interest Days by Payment Method, Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
The number of days of death claim interest on an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities death benefit share depends on how the claimant asked to be paid.

**Rule.** The interest days are extended past the payment date by **3** days where the claimant asked to be paid by check, by **1** day where the claimant asked for a transfer to another financial company, and not at all for a direct deposit. The payment method asked for is the one recorded on the death claim.

| Payment method asked for on the death claim | Interest days extended past the payment date |
|---|---|
| Check | 3 days |
| Transfer to another financial company | 1 day |
| Direct deposit | Not extended |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* interest that runs 40 days to the payment date counts 43 days for a check, 41 days for a transfer to another company and 40 days for a direct deposit.
